title: Три машины: кто вторым?
adaptation: Main road north-south (2.1 south/north, 2.4 west/east). Blue SUV on the main road from the north straight; red coupe on the main road from the south turns left to the west and yields to the oncoming blue; yellow wagon from the secondary road (west) straight east goes last. Each starts after the previous one has cleared its conflict.
